Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Intimation of the Schedule of Earnings Conference Call (investor/ analyst call) under Regulation 
30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby intimate that an Earnings Conference Call (Q1 FY 2026-27 
Results-group conference call through digital means) is scheduled to be held, with several Investors and 
Analysts, on Friday, August 14, 2026 at 11:00 Hrs (IST). 
 
The call will be initiated with a brief management discussion on the results for the quarter ended June 
30, 2026 followed by an interactive Question and Answer session.  
 
Enclosed are the details for the same.  
 
The audio clip and the transcript for the same will be uploaded on the website of the Company i.e. 
https://indigopaints.com/investors/analyst-investors-meets/ 
 
You are requested to take note of the same. 
 
Thanking you, 
For Indigo Paints Limited
